items.title: How CTBC Bank modernizes mainframe reverse engineering with a multi-agent pipeline on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: CTBC Bank moved COBOL reverse engineering for its core-system modernization from a single AI agent to a governed multi-agent pipeline on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. A Supervisor coordinates seven single-responsibility sub-agents with quality gates checked in code, delivering an about fourfold efficiency gain with the audit trail a regulated bank needs.
items.creator: James Chan
